learner_operation: Solve a Bernoulli ODE by reduction to a first-order linear ODE and integrating factors; select its general solution. Required reasoning: Normalize the ODE to y' + p(x)y = q(x)y^n.; Identify n, multiply by y^(-n), and set z=y^(1-n); the chain rule gives z' +(1-n)p z=(1-n)q.; Compute an elementary integrating factor, integrate the product derivative, and introduce an arbitrary constant.; Substitute back, invert the power with appropriate real branches/domains, and distinguish the resulting solution from distractors.
